name: The docks road: Central Tenebrae's south gate to the docks gate
doc: The user, 2026-11-17: move the shore south and build a walk down through the walls; space things out so nothing is stamped over anything. The docks (map 3) moved 20 chunks south and 15 east so they overlap nothing; this road, part of map 40, joins Central Tenebrae's south street to the hedge path inside the docks' wall. Cells are 128 world units in map 40's own coordinates (= world, map 40 sits at 0,0). floor: rectangles [cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1] (inclusive) of road surface; walls go on every empty cell next to the road. tools/road_patch.py builds data/patches/world_roads.json from this.
ends_doc: where to walk to cross: in map 40 the road's end at the docks; in map 3 the top of the hedge path (local coordinates of each map)
